visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A male character with short dark hair and a black-and-white striped shirt holds a thermal receipt in front of a white BUNNIT recycling kiosk. The setting is a brightly lit modern shopping mall with high ceilings and glass balustrades. He records himself in a selfie perspective with a neutral but engaged facial expression. (2) A close-up shows a white iPhone 16 Pro Max being inserted into a dark inspection tray at the bottom of the BUNNIT kiosk. The touchscreen above displays a blue progress bar and the text '功能檢測中' (Function testing in progress) with a percentage indicator. The lighting is bright and localized within the machine's interface. (3) The scene shifts to an indoor room where a female character in a white shirt and black skirt spins around; a yellow digital halo is edited over her head. Two iPhones are seen lying on a light-colored wooden floor, connected to charging cables. (4) The narrator is now inside a crowded Apple Store. He holds a white paper bag with the Apple logo and an orange iPhone retail box. The background is filled with blurred figures of shoppers and display tables with silver laptops and smartphones under warm, even lighting. (5) Returning to the kiosk, a close-up of the screen displays a cash valuation of '25,013' for an 'iPhone 16 Pro Max 1024G'. The narrator's hand enters the frame to tap the green '確認回收' (Confirm recycling) button. The machine's internal camera and UI elements are clearly visible. (6) The narrator holds a long thermal receipt showing the successful transaction. He stands in the middle of a shopping mall walkway with retail storefronts like Bershka visible in the background. He speaks directly to the camera while walking, using handheld camera movements.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main male creator, 1 featured female friend, and at least 10 other customers in the Apple Store background.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: An East Asian male with short, textured dark hair, wearing a horizontal black-and-white striped T-shirt and a crossbody bag strap.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video transitions between a modern shopping mall atrium with white walls and blue BUNNIT kiosks, an indoor domestic room with wooden floors, and a crowded Apple Store retail environment featuring light-wood tables and glass walls.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy male voice speaking Traditional Chinese at a fast pace. The BGM is a vibrant, upbeat electronic track with a steady drum machine beat. A sharp 'ding' SFX marks the presentation of the first receipt. (2) A digital 'whoosh' and UI 'click' sound occur as the scene cuts to the kiosk screen. The narrator's pitch rises in excitement as he describes the machine's speed. The BGM remains constant with a high-pass filter transition. (3) The acoustic space broadens with audible room tone and faint chatter of a crowd as the narrator enters the Apple Store. A paper rustling noise is heard as he handles a shopping bag. (4) A percussive UI 'pop' sound triggers as the final valuation is confirmed on the machine. The male voice becomes even more emphatic, emphasizing the dollar amount with clear articulation. (5) The video concludes with a thermal printer 'whir' and a final musical stinger that cuts out abruptly as the narrator delivers his final call to action.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Problem -> Comparison -> Practical Demo -> Result -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To showcase the convenience and higher cash value of using the BUNNIT self-service phone recycling kiosk compared to official Apple Store trade-in programs, which only offer store credit.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct recommendation of the brand 'BUNNIT', showing the machine location (ATT), and comparing it favorably to competitors.

high_inference.freeDescribe: High production value for short-form social media, utilizing rapid cuts and variety-show style text to maintain high engagement levels.
